title: Act: Render moonlight shaft, lamp glow, door light and vignette in the Phaser effect context
description: Implement the new cases with Phaser 3.90 game objects at spec.depth and destroy handles removing all created objects.
acceptance_criteria: Each new case sets depth to spec.depth

steps.action: Add a module-level helper parseColor(hex: string): number returning parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16), and use it in the ambientLight case too.
steps.expected: ambientLight still passes the same numeric colour

steps.action: Add case 'moonlightShaft' and case 'doorLight': each adds scene.add.rectangle(area.x, area.y, area.width, area.height, parseColor(spec.color), spec.alpha).setOrigin(0).setDepth(spec.depth).setBlendMode('ADD') and returns { destroy: () => rect.destroy() }.
steps.expected: Each case returns a handle whose destroy destroys one rectangle

steps.action: Add case 'lampGlow': scene.add.circle(spec.x, spec.y, spec.radius, parseColor(spec.color), spec.alpha).setDepth(spec.depth).setBlendMode('ADD'); destroy destroys the circle.
steps.expected: A circle is added at depth spec.depth

steps.action: Add case 'vignette': for each lineWidth in [24, 16, 8] create scene.add.rectangle(w/2, h/2, w, h) with w=scene.scale.width, h=scene.scale.height, then .setStrokeStyle(lineWidth, parseColor(spec.color), spec.alpha / 3).setDepth(spec.depth); collect in an array; destroy destroys all.
steps.code:
const bands = [24, 16, 8].map((lw) => scene.add.rectangle(w / 2, h / 2, w, h).setStrokeStyle(lw, parseColor(spec.color), spec.alpha / 3).setDepth(spec.depth));
return { destroy: () => bands.forEach((b) => b.destroy()) };
steps.expected: Three bands created and all destroyed together
